decommission.basis: The window is 45 consecutive days with no read and no write event on opal-data-cot (other than an excluded probe) on the named instrument, opal-organization-trail, whose ReadOnly and WriteOnly data-event selectors cover opal-data-cot/ today (measured). The window starts no earlier than that instrument's observed-live stamp (its configuration date is not read: Q8) and counts only after the Cottonwood cutover, meaning M13 to M26 have all landed. Any read or write event restarts the count. The readers that must be zero before the count runs are: the CloudFront origin and its OAI grant (M27, M28); the router rewrite (M13, M14); the IRPT directory readers (M15); the portal readers (M16); the cot event chain and producers (M17 to M24); the ingest mirror (M23); the mode marker (M22). The canonical bucket opal-data-cottonwood is NOT decommissioned by this plan. Each removal and each per-version delete is Andrew's word, act by act.
